website.description: A fence-post jack-o’-lantern with a sculpted body, a sliding rear door, a solar cork-light holder, a separate stem, and an internal steel disc for magnetic mounting. Both door variants have a closed rear volume for slicer infill and a flat underside for upright one-piece printing. A separate door fix fits the previously printed body.

instructions.title: Files and assembly views
instructions.text: For a new pumpkin, use the complete-set body, complete-set door, and stem. Download their STLs and assembly SCAD into one folder, retaining the filenames. The SCAD shows the matching complete set together or exploded. The roof is integral. For a previously printed pumpkin, use only the separate door-fix STL; its joint matches the older body. The two door versions fit different bodies. Each door is one piece and its STL is already upright on its flat underside.

instructions.title: Steel disc insertion
instructions.text: Use one 25 mm diameter × 2 mm thick steel disc. This body captures the disc under a printed cover, so insert it during a print pause before the cover begins. The disc top is 4.10 mm above the bed; set and verify the pause in the actual sliced job before the first cover layer. Do not reuse a layer number from a different slicing profile.

instructions.title: Door printing and assembly
instructions.text: Both doors have a closed rear volume and a flat underside at the guide stop. Print upright in the supplied STL orientation using 15% grid infill and supports disabled; the prepared 0.20 mm PETG Pro toolpaths contain no supports. Preserve the top cork opening and the 6 mm wire passage. Feed the strand through both passages, slide the door down from above, then fit the cork light with its supplied silicone sheath. Printing, bridge quality and physical fit of this revision remain unverified.

instructions.title: Fit and mounting
instructions.text: The complete-set body and door follow the original pumpkin surface, with a 0.3 mm fitting joint and a deliberately flat door underside. The door fix preserves the older body guides and rounded side-lobe backing. Both retain the previously printed and tested 18.5 mm cork bore and 22 mm insertion depth. Closed-mesh and continuous insertion-clearance checks pass. These closed-door revisions have not been printed; disc fit and magnetic holding strength require physical checks.

parts.name: Nickel-plated steel disc
parts.specification: 25 mm diameter × 2 mm thick. Fits the modelled internal disc pocket.

parts.name: Fence-side magnet
parts.specification: Fence-side cup magnet for the internal steel disc. Holding strength with the printed pumpkin has not been physically verified.

parts.name: Solar cork light
parts.specification: Uses the previously printed and tested 18.5 mm bore and 22 mm insertion depth with its supplied silicone sheath. Fits through the sculpted rear shell's top opening; the relocated holder is not yet physically tested.
